verdict_on_claim: Partly true, partly false. For the pure voice-AI players (Vapi, Retell, Bland, Synthflow) and the Western AI SDRs (Qualified Piper, Conversica, 11x, Artisan), the claim holds. None of them combine WhatsApp + Instagram + email + phone calls in one team inbox with a native CRM. They are single-channel or few-channel agents/APIs that write outcomes into Salesforce/HubSpot/GoHighLevel (e.g. Retell: 'write ... captured information ... back to your CRM'; Synthflow WhatsApp is 'US-region workspaces only' via your own Twilio; Qualified is website+email on Salesforce). The claim is NOT true in India: Jio Haptik's Interakt already sells a 'unified team inbox built for WhatsApp, Instagram' with AI agents that 'qualify leads' and a 'Sales CRM with auto-assigned owners and statuses', and Haptik sells WhatsApp+voice AI agents to SMBs from ₹10,000. That covers most of the concept, backed by Reliance Jio distribution. The defensible gap (from evidence this run, not exhaustive): (1) voice calls and email in the same inbox as WhatsApp/Instagram; (2) AI extraction of budget/location/timeline into structured CRM fields; (3) a match score against the business's own criteria, with priority sorting; (4) one integrated SMB product rather than Haptik-enterprise vs Interakt-SMB. FiguredOutAI should position against Interakt/Haptik, not against Vapi/Retell. The voice APIs are possible suppliers, not competitors.
notes: Headless Chromium (Playwright) failed every page with net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID through the agent proxy; I did not disable TLS verification and used WebFetch instead. WebFetch returns summaries from a small model, so some excerpts are summaries rather than verbatim (marked 'fetch-tool summary'). The Qualified SMS/WhatsApp mention was the summariser's own guess and is treated as unverified. Not checked: Vapi/Bland exact funding, Artisan pricing, Exotel INR pricing, Drift/Salesloft, Rezo.ai. LinkedIn/Instagram slugs in needs_login are partly inferred. Interakt is arguably a WhatsApp-CRM-segment competitor; it is included because it belongs to Jio Haptik and is the closest match found.
